title: TrustBoundary
description: Declares the policy-governed security boundary around an MCP server, MCP tool, remote agent, connector, or model endpoint. Every interop call must be scoped to a TrustBoundary before a delegated authority envelope or OperationCommand may be issued.

boundary_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for this trust boundary.

kind.description: Classification of the resource protected by this boundary.

spiffe_id.description: SPIFFE identity of the resource at this boundary.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for audit and diagnostic output.

capability_refs.description: Canonical capability references (capd:// URIs) associated with this boundary.

policy_hash.description: Hash of the policy document governing this boundary.

status.description: Lifecycle state; suspended and revoked boundaries fail closed for all operations.

trust_tier.description: Minimum danger class at which cross-boundary calls are evaluated.

attestation_required.description: Whether a valid AttestationBundle is required before issuing a grant at this boundary.

grant_required.description: Whether a valid, unexpired Grant is required before dispatching an OperationCommand across this boundary.

ledger_mode.description: Ledger write mode; 'required' means the operation is aborted if the ledger is unreachable.
